model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    leisure = 'nature reserve' 
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name = 'Kent County' AND border_type = 'county'))
),
max_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    MAX((ST_Value(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry)).[1]) AS max_elevation
  FROM 
    nature_reserve n
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry)
  GROUP BY 
    park_name
)
SELECT 
  park_name,
  max_elevation
FROM 
  max_elevation
WHERE 
  max_elevation = (SELECT MAX(max_elevation) FROM max_elevation);
```
